title: Your Life as an F1 Driver at Every Level (You Pay to Play)
hook: The odds of ever reaching a seat are roughly one in a million. Almost nobody tells you your family pays first.
body: POV: a composite hopeful climbing the real FIA single-seater pyramid -- from a scrappy kart track (VERIFIED: karting runs $50,000-$100,000+/year, paid by the family) through Formula 4 (VERIFIED: roughly $500,000/season) and Formula 3 (VERIFIED: up to about $1,000,000/season) to Formula 2, the last rung before F1 (VERIFIED: $2-3M/season, two seasons commonly totaling about $6,000,000, most drivers PAYING for the seat) -- to the FIA superlicence (VERIFIED: 40 points across 3 seasons) and one of only roughly 20-22 F1 seats that exist on Earth (odds estimated at roughly 1 in over 1,000,000) -- to an F1 rookie minimum (VERIFIED: about $500,000-$1,000,000), a world championship (grounded in real 2026-reported pay: Verstappen ~$70M/yr, Hamilton ~$60-70M/yr), and the sport's real $215,000,000 team cost cap (VERIFIED, 2026). The coda fact nobody puts on the trophy: the FIA superlicence fee itself is a base fee plus a per-point surcharge, over $1,100,000 for a champion's points tally (VERIFIED) -- the same pay-to-play logic from Level 1, now at nine figures. Formula 1's last on-track fatality was Jules Bianchi in 2014 (died 2015), the sport's first since Ayrton Senna in 1994 -- both cited as real historical fact. You, Robert, Silvio Conti, and Théo Rambert are a FICTIONAL COMPOSITE; no real, named driver is depicted as this episode's protagonist or rival. Watch the whole series -- every life, every level, every ladder somebody has to climb from the bottom. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real fact: the FIA superlicence needed to race in F1 costs a base fee plus a surcharge per championship point -- over $1.1M for a title-winning season. The 2026 F1 team cost cap is $215M. Karting alone runs $50-100K/year, paid by the family. Which level would break your budget first?
poll: Which level costs the most? LEVEL 01 (The Grid -- karting, paid by the family) / LEVEL 04 (Formula 2 -- $6M for two seasons, pay-to-race) / LEVEL 06 (The Race Seat -- one crash from the tire wall) / LEVEL 08 (World Champion -- $70M, and a $1.1M bill just for the licence)
